news.title: College of Engineering honors 163 staff members with record number of Bravo+ Awards
news.summary_en: The Purdue University College of Engineering honored 163 staff members from 20 units with Bravo+ Awards during the 2025-26 fiscal year, recognizing a record number of employees for their outstanding contributions to the college.

news.title: Seven Boilermaker Engineering students recognized as Big Ten Distinguished Scholars
news.summary_en: Seven Purdue Engineering students are among the 45 student athletes named Big Ten Distinguished Scholars during the 2025-2026 school year.

news.title: MSE's Strachan leads $19M NSF program to develop AI-driven labs for semiconductors, advanced materials
news.summary_en: Purdue University researchers will lead a $19 million effort to build an online, cloud-based lab that provides access to physical labs, simulations and AI tools to a national community of remote users for designing advanced materials and manufacturing processes for semiconductor, aerospace, defense and energy systems.
